Domain Battlegroup XVI is a branch of the Domain Military with the singular mission of the research and development of advanced technologies after the discovery of ancient ruins on the planet designated [Vector XV], before the collapse the Battlegroup answered directly to a figure within the Domain known as Arbiter Zero and worked closely with the various Scientific Research Institutes of the Domain.
